products_tech.name: Speculative Speculative Decoding (SSD)
products_tech.context: Parallelizes drafting and verification across hardware to hide drafting latency.

products_tech.name: vLLM
products_tech.context: Open-source baseline for autoregressive and speculative decoding.

products_tech.name: SGLang
products_tech.context: Fastest open engine with speculative decoding, beaten by SSD.

products_tech.name: Diffusion-MPC (DMPC)
products_tech.context: Diffusion-based multi-step action proposals and dynamics for model predictive control.

products_tech.name: Lay World Model
products_tech.context: JEPA-style world model using SIGREG to avoid latent collapse; 15M params, 50x faster.

products_tech.name: SIGREG
products_tech.context: Sketched Isotropic Gaussian regularization enforcing healthy latent distribution.

products_tech.name: Push-T
products_tech.context: Toy 2D task for world models and diffusion policy.

products_tech.name: DCLM
products_tech.context: General web data used in the data-constrained pretraining experiments.

products_tech.name: Llama 3 70B
products_tech.context: Model used in SSD's 300 tok/s benchmark.

products_tech.name: Dino World Model
products_tech.context: Wins on 3D tasks thanks to a large foundational image backbone.

frameworks_concepts.name: Inference as capability
frameworks_concepts.summary: Tokens/sec equals peak deliverable intelligence when performance scales with thinking.

frameworks_concepts.name: Speculative decoding
frameworks_concepts.summary: Small model drafts, big model verifies in parallel; verifying is cheaper than generating.

frameworks_concepts.name: Model predictive control (MPC)
frameworks_concepts.summary: Receding-horizon control using a dynamics model plus planner to maximize a known objective.

frameworks_concepts.name: JEPA
frameworks_concepts.summary: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture predicting next latent rather than next image.

frameworks_concepts.name: Representational collapse
frameworks_concepts.summary: Trivial latent-space minimum where every state maps the same; world models must avoid it.

frameworks_concepts.name: PAC-Bayes generalization bound
frameworks_concepts.summary: Bounds test loss by training loss plus a compression term; explains overparameterization.

frameworks_concepts.name: Soft inductive bias
frameworks_concepts.summary: Expressive models that bias toward simpler/compressible solutions to generalize.

frameworks_concepts.name: Scaling laws / asymptotes
frameworks_concepts.summary: Power-law fits whose asymptote estimates best-possible loss under infinite compute.

frameworks_concepts.name: Ensembling under data constraint
frameworks_concepts.summary: Multiple small models beat one compute-matched large model when data is fixed.

frameworks_concepts.name: Self-distillation
frameworks_concepts.summary: Distilling a model into a fresh same-size model improves loss, acting as implicit ensemble.
